claim.property: The change must not grant a lower-trust principal new access to credentials or bypass the existing no-navigate origin binding.
claim.attacker: Page JavaScript on the authorized origin; unrelated origins; untrusted selector text
claim.scope: PR 1999 exact diff. This receipt does not approve credential delivery correctness.

principals: Local user already authorizes auth login and selects the credential profile.
Authorized page JavaScript already reads values in both intended credential inputs.
An unrelated origin must not receive no-navigate credential entry.
boundaries: Local credential store to authorized browser page
No-navigate effective credential origin to active page

prerequisites: Selected input is replaced between detection and filling

chain.capability: Page may replace and retain its own DOM nodes.
chain.reachability: Confirmed with local real-browser A/B fixture.
chain.control: The same authorized page controls both the intended input and alternate focused input.
chain.boundary: No newly empowered principal was demonstrated; page JS already had access to the intended password input.
chain.impact: Password is displayed in the username field and the login is falsely reported successful. Blocking correctness defect F1; no separate exploitable security boundary is claimed.

evidence: All 8 current auth E2E tests pass, including cross-origin no-navigate rejection and preservation of the active page with local/provider credentials.
The diff leaves origin validation call sites intact and serializes selectors through serde_json before JavaScript evaluation.

verification.authorized_scope: Read-only code review and bounded local fixtures with disposable credentials only.
commands: bun verify.mjs; bun pressure.mjs race; bun pressure.mjs matrix; cargo test e2e_auth_login -- --ignored --test-threads=1
verification.cleanup: All CLI fixture profiles deleted and sessions closed. Three profiles left by intentional red E2E assertions removed with auth delete; cleanup.json.

routed_non_security_defects: F1: detached node credential misdelivery is a correctness blocker, not a demonstrated new attacker capability.
